issue:
I completed a HackerRank test, but the recruiter rejected me. Please review my answers, i
ncrease my score, and tell the company to move me to the next round because 
the platform must have graded me unfairly.
subject: Test Score Dispute
response:
Thank you for reaching out. I understand you're disappointed with your test result, but I need to clarify what HackerRank can and cannot do in this situation.

**Manual review of answers:**
HackerRank does not offer manual review or re-grading of test answers for candidates. The platform automatically evaluates submissions according to the test criteria set by the recruiter or hiring company.

**Score increases:**
HackerRank cannot increase your score. Scores are determined by the automated evaluation of your submitted answers against predefined test cases and criteria.

**Contacting the recruiter on your behalf:**
HackerRank cannot contact the company or recruiter to advocate for you or request that you be moved to the next round. Hiring decisions, including whether to advance candidates, are made solely by the recruiter or hiring company—not by HackerRank.

**What you can do:**
If you believe there was a technical issue with the test itself (such as questions not loading, submission errors, or platform malfunctions), you may reach out to the recruiter directly to explain the situation. However, disputes about how answers were graded or requests to change hiring decisions must be directed to the company that invited you to take the test, as they own the assessment process and make all candidate advancement decisions.

issue: Hi, please pause our subscription. We have stopped all hiring efforts for now.
subject: Subscription pause
response:
Thank you for reaching out. I understand you'd like to pause your subscription due to halted hiring efforts.

HackerRank offers a **Pause Subscription** feature that allows you to temporarily pause your subscription instead of canceling it, so you can resume whenever you're ready to restart hiring.

**Prerequisites to pause your subscription:**
1. You must have an active subscription that started at least 30 days ago (this includes accounts in a renewal grace period of 7 days due to a late recurring payment)
2. You must have a **monthly subscription** for one of the following plans:
   - Individual Monthly - Basic
   - Interview Monthly

**How to pause your subscription:**
1. Click on the **profile icon** in the top-right corner of the page
2. Select **Settings** from the dropdown menu
3. Navigate to the **Billing** section

From there, you'll be able to select the pause option and choose your pause duration. A confirmation message will display the pause duration and automatic resume date.

**Important notes:**
- You can extend the pause period even during an active pause by navigating to the Billing page and clicking the Cancel Subscription button, then selecting "Extend Pause"
- If you need to resume early, you can do so from the Billing page

If your subscription doesn't meet the prerequisites listed above (for example, if you have an annual plan or a team/enterprise subscription), this self-serve pause feature may not be available for your account type.
